tasks.prompt: Use the assigned AMind Engineering skill to produce an offline recovery decision as ONLY JSON. No execution, browsing, models, or writes. Task T for tenant A has item population [a,b], ordered stages read(item), verify(item, depends on read), combine(aggregate, depends on verify). Persisted journal: read/a succeeded attempt1; read/b running attempt1 after process crash; verify/a pending attempt0; verify/b pending attempt0; combine pending attempt0. Separately, an otherwise eligible pending developer-tool operation calls its authorization callback; the callback requests cancellation before dispatch. Report whether that operation can execute.
